summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespaces. In rdflib/namespace.py, Namespace.__contains__ does a prefix test (ref.startswith(str(self))), and ClosedNamespace.__contains__ returns any(ref == uri for uri in its stored term URIs), so _RDFNamespace inherits it. In test/test_namespace.py, I added five tests to NamespacePrefixTest covering prefix membership, SH, RDFS positive and negative cases, non-URIRef negatives (plain string and Literal), and RDF. Nothing was run, since tests and repository code were off-limits; the changes were verified by reading only. Nothing was committed.
